title: Galaxy Grid — quick-jump anchors & workspace switcher prototype
creator: Amira Chen
description: Summary: Prototype an alternate console navigation that surfaces frequent workspaces and cost-context anchors as a collapsible grid ('Galaxy Grid'). Goals: reduce time-to-switch between workspaces, make cost lenses and rollout controls discoverable, and provide a compact fallback for narrow viewports. Background: current sidebar is list-heavy and forces deep clicks for rollouts/cost telemetry. This experiment blends a dense visual grid with keyboard quick-jump indexes and progressive disclosure for rollout & cost actions. Constraints: must work with existing routing layer, maintain keyboard accessibility, and not add significant runtime UI JS (stay within console bundle limits). Acceptance criteria: (1) Prototype demonstrates switch < 2 clicks for 80% of common flows; (2) Keyboard nav + search landing works; (3) Rollout controls appear as a 2-step inline affordance and hit usability targets in initial testing; (4) No regression in console load metrics beyond 5%.
acceptance_criteria: Switch to most-used workspace in <=2 clicks for 80% of flows
Workspace quick-jump index reachable via keyboard shortcut
Rollout/canary controls visible within grid affordance without leaving list context
Cost lens link appears as contextual chip with token-cost preview
